description: LFU cache (design choice: frequency tracking strategy)
prompt: Implement a class `LFUCache` with a fixed capacity, constructor `LFUCache(capacity: int)`, `get(key: int) -> int` (returns the value or -1 if absent, and counts as a use), and `put(key: int, value: int) -> None` (inserts/updates; if over capacity, evicts the LEAST FREQUENTLY used key, breaking ties by least-recently-used among equal frequencies).
test_suite:
import unittest

class Test(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_basic_get_put(self):
        c = LFUCache(2)
        c.put(1, 10)
        c.put(2, 20)
        self.assertEqual(c.get(1), 10)
    def test_evicts_least_frequent(self):
        c = LFUCache(2)
        c.put(1, 10)
        c.put(2, 20)
        c.get(1)
        c.get(1)
        c.put(3, 30)
        self.assertEqual(c.get(2), -1)
        self.assertEqual(c.get(1), 10)
        self.assertEqual(c.get(3), 30)
    def test_missing_key(self):
        c = LFUCache(1)
        self.assertEqual(c.get(99), -1)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
